title: Individuum
tagline: Individuum is a automated market for web tasks that guarantees their completion upon required specifications, and ensure transparent and secure payment.

description: Individuum simplifies, automates and secures task delegation. Clients can list their web tasks to our marketplace or delegate them to a party that they want to share the task with. This involves providing clear instructions, outlining specific requirements, and setting a fixed price for each task. The platform then matches your task with workers who can complete it efficiently. One of Individuum's key strengths is its guaranteed satisfaction for the completion to the set requirmemts. Both parties will be secured by our integrated payment system throughout the transaction. The person who owns the listing has to lock the amount of tokens that they have specified in the listing. The worker who satisfied the tasks requirements will automatically receive the tokens once the task is automatically verified. With this system, both parties are not able to cheat.
how_its_made: For a seamless sign in/sign up process we use Web3Auth. To get the Web2 TLS Data we use TLS Notary and their integrated MPC to define the tasks outlines. The smart contract, including the verifier and escrow contract are made using Arbitrum Stylus. The backend is built using Rust and the frontend in Next.js.
